column8: a file named only a year: the title is the year, but is it also the year of the video?
year plus tags and no title: title 1992 with no year, or title 1992 and year 1992
20130 is no year; may be Amen 2013 with a stray 0 (a truncated tag), which would be Amen with year 2013
a number spelled out after itself: the whole name, or just 916
an alias: the parser has no alias field, so the title may be the first name or the whole text
an alias, with the letters spaced

column1: Godzilla Minus One A K A Gojira -1 0.mkv
column8: an alias; the -1 0 is Gojira -1.0, the film's own title
mathematical monospace AsH is a tag (like DVDWO) or part of the title; the same name also appears as plain AsH Hitler
three letters, or three letters of a longer name cut off
MM is a channel's tag in the survey, but a bare two letter word before a title is also a title's first word
as MM Premalu, plus the short language word
Superhit Malayalam Movie is the uploader's wording; how much of it to drop is a policy
AK may be the channel's second tag or the first word of the title (Ayyappanum Koshiyum is a film of its own)
